narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. That same month, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, the ghost's fallback no longer matching yours. At the layoff in month {layoff_month}, the money stood furthest apart, the ghost holding {layoff_net_worth_gap}. In month {ghost_lowest_month}, the ghost's money sat at its lowest since the split, ending with {net_worth_gap}. Its days felt barely different from yours, with Life ending {life_gap}.
